title: freeCodeCamp
description: A free, open-source curriculum and community platform for learning to code, covering web development, data visualization, and more through interactive coding challenges.
solution_overview: A full-stack learning platform with an interactive curriculum, coding challenges, and certification projects, built as a large community-maintained monorepo.
development_steps: Clone the repository and read CONTRIBUTING.md
Set up the local development environment per the README
Look for issues labeled 'good first issue' or 'help wanted'
Open a pull request following the project's contribution guidelines

title: React
description: A declarative, component-based JavaScript library for building user interfaces, maintained by Meta and a large open-source community.
solution_overview: Implements a virtual DOM and component model to let developers build interactive UIs declaratively, with a reconciliation algorithm to efficiently update the real DOM.
development_steps: Clone the repository and read CONTRIBUTING.md
Build the project locally following the README
Explore the packages/ directory to understand the codebase structure
Look for issues labeled 'good first issue'

title: Vue.js
description: An approachable, performant, and versatile JavaScript framework for building user interfaces and single-page applications.
solution_overview: A progressive framework combining a reactive data-binding system with a component architecture, designed to be adoptable incrementally.

title: Angular
description: A platform and framework for building single-page client applications using HTML and TypeScript, maintained by Google.

title: Svelte
description: A UI framework that shifts work from the browser to a compile step, producing highly efficient imperative code that updates the DOM directly.

title: Tailwind CSS
description: A utility-first CSS framework for rapidly building custom user interfaces without leaving your HTML.

title: Express
description: A minimal and flexible Node.js web application framework providing a robust set of features for building web and mobile applications and APIs.

title: NestJS
description: A progressive Node.js framework for building efficient, reliable, and scalable server-side applications, using TypeScript and inspired by Angular's architecture.

title: Django
description: A high-level Python web framework that encourages rapid development and clean, pragmatic design, following the model-template-view pattern.

title: Flask
description: A lightweight WSGI web application framework in Python, designed to make getting started quick and easy, with the ability to scale up to complex applications.

title: Node.js
description: An open-source, cross-platform JavaScript runtime environment built on Chrome's V8 engine, for building server-side and networking applications.

title: Supabase
description: An open-source Firebase alternative providing a Postgres database, authentication, instant APIs, edge functions, and storage.

title: Appwrite
description: An end-to-end backend server for web, mobile, and Flutter developers, covering authentication, databases, storage, and functions.

title: Strapi
description: An open-source headless content management system that gives developers full control to build customizable APIs quickly.

title: Ghost
description: An open-source, professional publishing platform built on a modern Node.js technology stack, designed for independent journalism and blogging.
